summary: Inspected all retained responsive captures and exact JSON probes at 1440, 1280, 1024, 768, 390 and 375 px, then verified current DOM geometry and controls in fresh isolated read-only browser contexts at the same widths. Fonts are ready and global overflow is zero from 1440 through 390, but the mobile layout is unhealthy; 375 has 14 px document overflow.
issues: RESP-01 critical horizontal overflow: expected document width to remain within the 375 px viewport; actual scrollWidth exceeds clientWidth by 14 px and the product-related 'Dodaj do koszyka' control ends at x 387.921875. Constrain the related-card grid/control widths at the 375 breakpoint.

RESP-02 high mobile rich-text layout: expected derived responsive content to use the available 335 px (375 viewport) and 350 px (390 viewport) content area; actual product-expanded-description is only 187 px and 202 px wide at x 94, producing page heights about 14,199 px and 13,413 px and a visibly unusable narrow text column. Make the expanded description span the mobile content width.

RESP-03 high tab controls: expected all product-tab controls to remain reachable and visibly navigable on mobile; actual tab list is fixed at 650 px, with 'Stosowanie' ending at x 410 and the later 'Opinie'/'Pliki do pobrania' controls extending to x 540/x 670. Implement a clear wrapping or accessible horizontal-scroll treatment within the viewport.

RESP-04 high responsive cards: at 768, 390 and 375 the related products collapse into tiny scattered fragments with excessive blank space instead of readable cards; at 375 one cart link itself overflows. Reflow related cards to a stable one- or two-column derived mobile layout.
